title: Mid Brain Activation: Truth or Trick?
description:
Mid brain activation, blindfold reading, and intuition process claims are going viral across social media. Children bending spoons, reading without seeing, and spinning objects without touching them have amazed millions. But is this real mind power or just a clever trick?

In this video, we break down mid brain activation, Sri Sri Ravishankar's Art of Living’s intuition process, and blindfold reading demonstrations using simple scientific tests. We examine spoon bending, paper spinning on a pivot, and so-called “third eye activation” to understand what’s really happening.

If you’ve ever wondered whether mind power is real, whether kids can actually read blindfolded, or whether intuition training unlocks hidden abilities, this video gives you a rational, evidence-based perspective.

If you’ve searched for mid brain activation, blindfold reading truth, intuition process, mind power tricks, this video gives you the rational perspective. Don’t forget to subscribe, like, comment, and share to support science-based content.

⏱ CHAPTERS (17:00 Total)

00:00 – The Viral Video Everyone Is Sharing
01:10 – The Three “Impossible” Demonstrations
03:20 – Why It Looks So Convincing
05:10 – Spoon Bending Breakdown
07:20 – Blindfold Reading Tested
10:00 – Paper Spinning Experiment (Glass Test)
12:30 – The Psychology Behind It
14:30 – The Truth About “Mid Brain Activation”
16:00 – Final Verdict: Real or Trick?
